newsitem.title: UK: John Menzies expects satisfactory year.
newsitem.headline: John Menzies expects satisfactory year.

text.p: British retailer John Menzies Plc expects a satisfactory result for the year as trading continues similar to last year, chairman John Menzies told the annual meeting.
"Trading patterns have continued the trends of the last year," he said, "we are well positioned to achieve a satisfactory result for the year as a whole."
He said the new financial year had started quietly and the group expected profits to continue the swing in favour of the second half as seen in recent results.
Menzies said there had been a good performance in news, books and stationery and patchy demand for toys, music, video and computer games.
He said sales at its Early Learning Centre children's stores had been flat year-on-year and initiatives had been taken to address this.
